name: perai-view
description: Interactive 3D globe of simulated AI-assistant activity. Repository-level scripts that orchestrate frontend/, backend/ and ai-classifier/.

scripts.setup: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefix backend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
